purpose: Prove that the native Admin-compatible order detail remains a complete operator projection while lifecycle state changes.
success_outcome: A real local fixture demonstrates all required operator fields and native lifecycle projections without a custom Admin surface.
anti_goals: Do not build Admin UI or a custom order route.
Do not alter production order/payment behavior to make the fixture pass.
Do not include real customer or provider data in evidence.

forbidden_scope: custom Admin/storefront lifecycle UI or route
production data, secrets, credentials, tokens, cookies, direct stock mutation

success_checks: Native Admin order detail contains contacts, products, delivery data, payment method/status, order status, total, and checkout_state.
New orders show personal_request; controlled legacy card/sbp/sberpay values remain historical offline-request labels and are not provider evidence.
The installed dashboard exposes metadata through its order detail fields/metadata editor and provides native mark-as-paid and cancel actions.
Lifecycle fixtures preserve required fields while projecting payment, fulfillment, completion, unpaid cancel, and refund states.

Fixtures distinguish cancellation-origin, partial, and cumulative full refunds, and prove the metadata editor/direct Admin API cannot change or delete any protected workflow key, explicitly including checkout_reservation_item_ids and checkout_reservation_line_ids, while unrelated operator metadata remains editable.
No custom Admin replacement, direct database browser route, alternate order record, or unsafe fixture mutation is used.
evidence_required: Native order detail payload with every required operator field.
Field-preservation and lifecycle projection output, including cancellation-origin/single partial/cumulative partial/final full refund fixtures and every protected-metadata negative path.
Fixture cleanup/privacy and T3 closure evidence.

stop_conditions: The native Admin-compatible boundary cannot expose one or more required fields.
Fixture proof requires a custom Admin replacement or direct database browser access.
Cleanup cannot be proven isolated from unrelated orders/inventory.
